purpose: Catalog of privacy-policy sections keyed by service category. Lists required TOPICS only – no finished legal prose. Used by privacy.services-documented to verify that every detected service has a section covering every required topic.

topicDefinitions.controller: Name and contact details of the controller (Art. 13(1)(a) GDPR); for embeds also any joint controllership (Art. 26).
topicDefinitions.legalBasis: Legal basis per purpose (Art. 13(1)(c), Art. 6(1)); plus § 25 TDDDG basis for device access where relevant.
topicDefinitions.recipients: Recipients or categories of recipients incl. processors (Art. 13(1)(e)).
topicDefinitions.thirdCountryTransfer: Transfer to third countries and the mechanism (adequacy/DPF, SCC, Art. 49) (Art. 13(1)(f)).
topicDefinitions.rights: Data-subject rights, right to withdraw consent, right to object, right to complain (Art. 13(2)(b)-(d)).

disclaimer: Topic lists are a technical completeness checklist, not legal advice; sections marked lawyerReview need review by a qualified lawyer before release.
